truncation_probe.seasons: R2 target and early flag at t from closes <= t

gate_I_instruments.rule: median dCAGR >= 0, share dCAGR > 0 >= 60%, share dDD <= +3 pp >= 80%, pooled bootstrap median d >= 0 (2000 paths/instrument)

gate_P_plateau.rule: >= 5 of 6 neighbours with base m=2 CAGR > C0 and no neighbour with max DD > C0 + 1 pp

params.signals: production E2 1.1.0 on price closes: SMA200, 252-session price return > 0, close > 126-session max/min midpoint; 2 of 3
